name: 29655 · Iva, SC
findings: ZIP 29655 (Iva) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29655 (Iva) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
